import urllib.request
import re

# Try to fetch Wikipedia page about penguin species
try:
    url = "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_penguin_species"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    response = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10)
    html = response.read().decode('utf-8')
    
    # Search for chinstrap related content
    idx = html.lower().find('chinstrap')
    if idx > 0:
        # Print surrounding context
        chunk = html[max(0,idx-200):idx+2000]
        print("=== Wikipedia chinstrap section ===")
        print(chunk[:2000])
        
        # Look for population data
        pop_matches = re.findall(r'(?:population|breeding pairs|total)[^<]*', chunk, re.IGNORECASE)
        print("\n=== Population mentions ===")
        for m in pop_matches[:10]:
            print(m)
    else:
        print("Chinstrap not found in HTML")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error fetching Wikipedia: {e}")

print("\n\n--- Trying Nature article ---")
try:
    url2 = "https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-020-2127-0"

        print(chunk2[:2000])
    else:
        print("Chinstrap not found in Nature HTML")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error fetching Nature: {e}")
